fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled XML reaches xmlParseElement after xmlParseElementStart pushed a name; when the input ends prematurely (CUR==0), nameNr is at least 1.

pushTab is only allocated inside nameNsPush when ctxt->sax2 is true; if sax2 is false (SAX1 handler), pushTab remains NULL and this dereference reads from a near-zero address, causing the bad-cast/null-pointer crash.

fine_trace.code: xmlFatalErrMsgStrIntStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_TAG_NOT_FINISHED, "Premature end of data in tag %s line %d\n", name, line, NULL);
fine_trace.note: The invalid line value read from the NULL pushTab is passed into the error-reporting path, completing the crash.
